runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game nf_23x --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-security/nf-ball-accelerator-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. The test starts with all three magnets enabled and LEFT selected; Up selects the next magnet and Enter toggles the selected one. The host pulses each ramp opto at public 1 for 150 ms; the ROM answers left opto 46 with public 6, centre opto 47 with 5 and right opto 48 with 3, each only while its magnet is enabled. Readings describe the icons: a magnet symbol, filled while the coil is energized, or a cross for a disabled magnet with a bar while its opto is blocked; 'boxed' is the selection frame.

named_action_observations.label: T.16 with the magnet enabled, a 150 ms pulse of ramp opto 46 (46 with all three magnets enabled) makes the ROM fire public 6 once
T.16 with that magnet disabled, a pulse of ramp opto 46 (46 with LEFT disabled) fires nothing
T.16 with the magnet enabled, a 150 ms pulse of ramp opto 47 (47 with LEFT disabled) makes the ROM fire public 5 once
T.16 with the magnet enabled, a 150 ms pulse of ramp opto 48 (48 with LEFT disabled) makes the ROM fire public 3 once
T.16 with that magnet disabled, a pulse of ramp opto 47 (47 with LEFT and CENTER disabled) fires nothing
T.16 with the magnet enabled, a 150 ms pulse of ramp opto 48 (48 with LEFT and CENTER disabled) makes the ROM fire public 3 once
T.16 with that magnet disabled, a pulse of ramp opto 48 (48 with all three disabled) fires nothing
T.16 with the magnet enabled, a 150 ms pulse of ramp opto 48 (48 with RIGHT enabled again) makes the ROM fire public 3 once

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
